historical_references.reference: Naafi ibn Jabal was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad and a respected scholar of Islamic law. He was known for his expertise in the interpretation of the Qur'an and was a strong advocate for the application of Islamic law in everyday life.
historical_references.context: During the formative years of the Islamic community, scholars like Naafi played a crucial role in interpreting the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad and establishing the legal framework for the emerging Islamic state.
